description.value: Daan Go Cake Lab is a specialty dessert bakery founded by award-winning chef Christopher Siu, known for imaginative Asian-inspired creations like a durian-shaped mousse cake and a Hong Kong milk tea mousse cake built on an Ovaltine pineapple-bun crumb base. The Vancouver location on West 7th Avenue is one of two BC outposts (the other in Richmond) with a sibling presence in Toronto. A touring cyclist stopping here would find an eclectic selection of signature cakes, macarons, and croissants in a neighbourhood bakery format.
